botMessages.message: Hi! I can find Contacts for you by name, email, phone, Account, job title or location, and answer questions about them. I can also answer scholarship policy and process questions from published Knowledge articles.
Something went wrong while searching Contacts. Please try again. If it keeps happening, contact your Salesforce administrator.
